SELECT id, title, summary, context, revision, parent_id AS parentId, epic_url AS epicUrl, home_path AS homePath,
  created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM neo_concerns WHERE id = ?

INSERT INTO neo_concerns
              (id, title, summary, context, revision, created_at, updated_at)
              VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
              RETURNING id, title, summary, context, revision, parent_id AS parentId, epic_url AS epicUrl, home_path AS homePath,
  created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
